_comment: Source of truth for everything on the cards that a machine can know: the account-level `profile` numbers and the per-repo `repos` list. `refresh_stats.py` rewrites the machine fields from the GitHub API, then `build.py` redraws the SVGs. Editorial fields - per-repo `name`/`description`/`language_color` and `profile.login` - are hand-tuned for the canvas and the neon palette, so the refresher never touches them.
